headline: Lula Allies Press Brazil Central Bank for Rate Cut Ahead of Copom Decision
summary: Allies of Brazilian President Lula are increasing pressure on the central bank for an interest rate cut ahead of the Copom meeting, while the benchmark Selic rate stands at 13.75%.
why: Brazil's Selic rate is the primary monetary policy tool used by Banco Central do Brasil to control inflation, directly influencing government debt servicing costs and domestic equity valuations.

impacts.name: Brazil Selic rate
impacts.why: Political pressure targets the central bank's benchmark interest rate policy.
